'''Ollobo''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he worked as a [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ollobo appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
